# 303box

> 303box is a free browser-based 16-step 303 acid bassline and synchronized rhythm workstation.

Canonical URL: https://303box.com/
Turkish landing page: https://303box.com/tr/

## Core capabilities
- Program 16-step 303 patterns with note, octave, accent, slide, trigger, tie and rest states.
- Choose sawtooth or square waveform and shape Tune, Cutoff, Resonance, Env Mod, Decay and Accent.
- Add Delay and Distortion to the 303 preview.
- Run bass and rhythm from one shared browser audio clock through the Acid Console.
- Start bass and rhythm together with a global transport or control either part independently.
- Control Master, 303 and Rhythm levels independently and mute either musical layer.
- Apply shared Swing to the 16-step timing.
- Apply Pump sidechain: active kick steps duck the 303 level and recover musically.
- Preview the 303 and rhythm with the Web Audio API.
- Inspect the signal with a compact oscilloscope and FFT display.
- Connect supported MIDI hardware through the Web MIDI API and send note messages plus optional MIDI clock.
- Program a synchronized six-part rhythm machine: bass drum, snare drum, hand clap, tom, closed hi-hat and open hi-hat.
- Rhythm voice map: TR-909 bass drum; TR-606 snare drum; TR-606 closed/open hi-hats; TR-808 Clap; TR-808 Low Tom, with the source architecture's real clap/tom alternatives where available.
- Generate musically structured acid and rhythm patterns.
- Export the visible 303 pattern and rhythm pattern as JPG images.
- Store working sessions locally in the browser.

## Historical coverage
The site includes 303 history and educational coverage of acid-house sequencing culture, including the role of early 303 experimentation and the continuing hardware/software ecosystem.
